summary.text: Chipalo Street is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 37-Position 2 since January 9, 2023, and he is a candidate for Washington State Senate District 37 in the November 3, 2026 general election against fellow Democrat Tatiana Brown.
He is an information technology professional who worked at Microsoft.

paragraphs.text: Street lives in Seattle and earned bachelor's and graduate degrees in computer science from Brown University in 2006 and 2007.
While at Brown, he co-founded a start-up business in remote cardiac rehabilitation.
He worked at Microsoft, where he had four patents granted and advised the chief technology officer on emerging technologies, and he also started a real estate company.
He co-founded the Teacher Scientist Partnership at Technology Access Foundation Academy and served on the Public Policy Impact Council at the United Way of King County.
Street succeeded Kirsten Harris-Talley (D) in the House.
In the 2023-2024 session he was vice chair of the Finance Committee and served on the Environment & Energy and Innovation, Community & Economic Development, & Veterans committees.
